attributes.title: Key Attributes
attributes.subtitle: Market records can include these environmental and commercial fields when the data is disclosed.

0.title: Carbon Intensity (CI)
0.description: Measured in gCO₂e/MJ. The primary metric for comparing the environmental impact of different fuels and pathways. Lower CI = lower lifecycle emissions.

1.title: Feedstock Pathway
1.description: The production route from raw material to finished fuel. Determines CI, regulatory eligibility, and premium potential. Examples: waste cooking oil, sugarcane bagasse, green hydrogen + CO₂.

why.title: Why Verdaxis Exists
why.subtitle: The transition to low-carbon fuels is hindered by fragmented markets, inconsistent data, and compliance uncertainty.

0.title: Scarce Molecules
0.body: Low-carbon fuel supply is limited. Every molecule needs verified provenance and transparent pricing.

1.title: Fragmented Standards
1.body: RED III, 45Z, RenovaBio, FuelEU Maritime, IMO NZF — different rules, different metrics, one platform.

2.title: Double-Counting Risk
2.body: Without chain-of-custody integrity, the same environmental attribute can be claimed multiple times.

3.title: Scope 3 Pressure
3.body: End-users face increasing pressure to prove real emissions reductions, not just purchase certificates.

0.title: Integrity First
0.description: Each feature is tested with real participants before expanding. We don't launch features until they're production-ready.

1.title: Deliberate Scaling
1.description: We add participants and volume gradually. A platform that works perfectly for 10 users is better than one that crashes for 1,000.

2.description: Every feature is designed with compliance in mind. We build within regulatory frameworks, not around them.

principles.title: Guiding Principles
principles.subtitle: Three foundational principles guide every decision at Verdaxis.

0.title: Trust Before Liquidity
0.description: The platform must earn credibility before scaling volume. We prioritise verified participants, auditable processes, and regulatory alignment over rapid growth.

1.title: Rules Before Prices
1.description: Market rules, compliance standards, and attribute definitions are established before trading begins. This ensures every participant operates under the same framework.

2.title: Independence & Neutrality
2.description: Verdaxis operates as a neutral infrastructure provider. Platform interests are structurally separated from participant interests.

structuralRoles.title: Structural Separation of Roles
structuralRoles.subtitle: Verdaxis maintains clear boundaries between platform operation, market participation, and verification to prevent conflicts of interest.

0.title: Platform Operator
0.description: Verdaxis as the technology and registry provider. Responsible for platform integrity, rule enforcement, and data security. Does not take proprietary trading positions.

1.title: Market Participants
1.description: Producers, buyers, traders, and financiers who use the platform. Subject to platform rules, KYC requirements, and compliance standards.

2.title: Verification Bodies
2.description: Independent third-party certifiers who verify environmental attributes. Accredited by recognised standards bodies. Not affiliated with Verdaxis.

points.0: Verdaxis treats all participant data with equal confidentiality and does not use individual trading data to advantage any party.
points.1: Aggregated, anonymised market data may be published for price discovery purposes.
points.2: Individual trade data is never shared with competitors or used for proprietary analysis.
points.3: Participants retain ownership of their data and can export it at any time.

points.0: If Verdaxis, its affiliates, or its principals engage in fuel trading activity, this is fully disclosed to all participants.
points.1: Any affiliated trading activity is subject to the same rules as all other participants — no preferential access, no information advantage.
points.2: An independent oversight function monitors for potential conflicts.
points.3: Participants can report concerns through a confidential channel.

0.title: 1. Information We Collect
0.body: Verdaxis Exchange collects information you provide when creating an account, placing orders, or contacting support. This includes your name, email address, company information, and transaction data.

1.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
1.body: We use your information to operate the exchange platform, process transactions, ensure regulatory compliance (EU ETS, FuelEU), and communicate important updates about your account.

2.title: 3. Product Analytics
2.body: Essential browser storage supports sign-in, language, and theme preferences. With your choice, optional self-hosted, cookie-free analytics processes normalized page paths, allowlisted product events, and technical request information used to derive short-lived sessions. Analytics excludes names, email addresses, organization names, URL queries and invitation codes, and transaction content. Session replay is disabled.

3.title: 4. Data Protection
3.body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data. Data is encrypted in transit and protected at rest.

4.title: 5. Your Rights
4.body: Subject to applicable law, you may have rights to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, or port your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact privacy@verdaxis.exchange.

0.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
0.body: By accessing Verdaxis Exchange, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the platform.

1.title: 2. Platform Description
1.body: Verdaxis Exchange is a compliance-first marketplace for low-carbon marine fuels. The platform facilitates transactions between fuel suppliers and shipping companies.

2.title: 3. Account Responsibilities
2.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities under your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.

3.title: 4. Trading Rules
3.body: All trades executed on the platform are subject to our trading rules and settlement procedures. Bids and offers are binding once confirmed.

4.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
4.body: Verdaxis Exchange is provided "as is". We are not liable for trading losses, data interruptions, or third-party service failures beyond our reasonable control.

5.title: 6. Contact
5.body: For questions about these terms, email legal@verdaxis.exchange.
